nodes.label: Offline Support Feature
nodes.rationale: Offline support uses optimistic updates: expenses added offline are shown immediately in UI, queued to localStorage, and synced when connectivity returns. Auth bypass uses cached user profile to avoid re-prompting. Session expiry shows a small banner rather than auto-prompting, balancing UX and security.

nodes.label: Version / Build Number Feature
nodes.rationale: Version and build timestamp are baked into the JS bundle at build time via Vite defines (__APP_VERSION__, __BUILD_TIME__), ensuring they are always accurate for the deployed build with no runtime overhead or API calls.

nodes.label: localStorage Caching Strategy
nodes.rationale: Auth token kept in sessionStorage (budget_auth) for security; offline auth cache goes to localStorage to survive browser close. Data cache key is budget_data_cache_${sheetId} to isolate per-spreadsheet. Queue items with retries > 3 are surfaced as failures rather than silently dropped.

nodes.label: Optimistic UI Updates Pattern
nodes.rationale: When an expense is queued offline, it is shown immediately in the UI to preserve perceived responsiveness. The local data state is manually updated when { queued: true } is returned, without waiting for a server round-trip.

nodes.label: PDF Support for Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Two approaches considered: Claude API (server-side PDF parsing, ~$0.04/statement, data leaves device) vs PDF.js (client-side, free, stays on device, messy for some bank formats). Decision parked pending user preference on privacy vs convenience trade-off.

nodes.label: Onboarding Wizard
nodes.rationale: Two options considered: Option A (first-time setup wizard for deployers) vs Option B (UI walkthrough for family members). Option B recommended, shown once per user account tracked in UserSettings.

nodes.label: Statement Reconciliation (In Progress)
nodes.rationale: Being built on feature/reconciliation branch. Includes PDF upload with text and image/scanned fallback via Claude vision, password-protected PDF support, multi-document session, AI-assisted transaction extraction, fuzzy vendor matching, and Netlify Function for server-side Anthropic API key (not exposed in browser).

nodes.label: Hybrid Caching Layer
nodes.rationale: Parked as large-scale planning. Aggressive localStorage read-cache to reduce Sheets API latency. Upstash Redis considered if multi-user ever needed.
